description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Delete one of the user's GearHost CloudSites (by domain): its hosting, files, certificates, DNS, HA replicas and Git Push repo, exactly like deleting it in the GearHost panel. Destructive - set confirm:true. Databases linked to the site are KEPT (unlinked, still in the account) unless delete_databases:true. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, deleted, databases }.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete.

delete_databases.description: Also permanently delete the databases linked to this site. Default false: they are kept.

name: delete_my_site
title: Delete my site
